national_news.title: Calcutta High Court Cancels OBC Certificates Issued Under Revised Rules
bullets: Calcutta High Court cancels OBC certificates issued under OBC-A and OBC-B classifications introduced by the previous Trinamool Congress government in West Bengal.
Holders of these certificates will now be treated as belonging to the general category.
The controversy dates back to 2010, when the state divided OBC communities into two classifications.

national_news.title: IMD forecasts extremely heavy rainfall in Odisha and Gangetic West Bengal today
bullets: IMD issued a red colour warning for heavy to very heavy rainfall over Gangetic West Bengal and Odisha today.
Heavy rainfall is expected to prevail over several states including Jammu and Kashmir, Ladakh, and East Uttar Pradesh.
A low-pressure area has formed over the North Bay of Bengal, leading to the heavy rainfall forecast.

national_news.title: Parliament passes bill to enhance funding and development of cooperative sector
bullets: The National Co-operative Development Corporation (NCDC) (Amendment) Bill, 2026 aims to further amend the National Co-operative Development Corporation Act, 1962.
The Bill allows the Corporation to undertake its activities in industrial goods and provides for direct loans and grants to co-operatives.
State governments can now extend funding from the Corporation to any entity engaged in co-operative development.

national_news.title: BCCI confirms India vs Afghanistan T20 International series in September
bullets: India will host a three-match T20 International series against Afghanistan in September.
The series will be played at the Arun Jaitley Cricket Stadium in Delhi from 13 to 17th next month.
The series is part of Afghanistan's Future Tours Program and supports the growth of cricket in Afghanistan.

national_news.title: Thailand to elevate school safety after mass shooting
bullets: Thailand's cabinet approved an Education Ministry's proposal to elevate school safety to a national agenda.
The move aims to strengthen prevention and response at educational institutions systematically.
All schools have been designated School Safety Zones and must set up centres for protection of rights, liberties, and safety.

national_news.title: India wins 3 gold, 1 silver, and 1 bronze in Commonwealth Fencing Championship
bullets: India won a total of 29 medals, including 8 gold, 7 silver, and 14 bronze, in the Commonwealth Championship.
The Indian fencing team secured a gold-silver victory in the Senior Women's Foil category.
Kanaglakshmi won the gold medal, while Joys Ashitha took silver in the Senior Women's Foil category.

national_news.title: Sports Ministry suspends TTFI’s recognition till restoration of its governance structure
bullets: The Sports Ministry suspended the recognition of the Table Tennis Federation of India (TTFI) due to governance deficiencies.
The Ministry cited TTFI's failure to conduct elections on time as one of the reasons for the suspension.
An ad-hoc committee will be formed by the Indian Olympic Association to administer the sport.

national_news.title: Indian Grandmaster R Praggnanandhaa defeats Javokhir Sindarov in Sinquefield Cup
bullets: Indian Grandmaster R Praggnanandhaa secured his first victory in the Sinquefield Cup.
The match was a part of the Grand Chess Tour, a prestigious international chess tournament.
Praggnanandhaa dominated the game from start to finish, ultimately defeating Javokhir Sindarov.

national_news.title: BRICS economies are major growth engines of global economy, says FM Sitharaman
bullets: BRICS economies are among the major engines of global growth, according to FM Sitharaman.
Public capital should act as a catalyst for private investment, rather than a substitute for it.
BRICS economies face challenges in attracting private capital, requiring measures to build investor confidence and maintain stability.

national_news.title: India's retail inflation rises to 4.45%, remains above RBI's target of 4%
bullets: Retail inflation accelerated to 4.45% on an annual basis in July.
Inflation remained above the Reserve Bank of India's target of 4% for the second consecutive month.
Food prices remained elevated, contributing to the higher inflation reading.

bihar_news.title: Bihar CM Inspects Proposed Medical College and Hospital Site in Gopalganj
bullets: Bihar CM inspected the proposed site for Maa Thawe Medical College and Hospital in Gopalganj.
He provided necessary directions for the project.
The CM also performed puja and aradhana at Thawe Temple, praying for the state's prosperity, peace, and happiness.
